question: Can the existing native public causal cells preserve physically learned action preferences while recycling active sites for new learning, using only the original 7 active + 9 retained cell budget and unchanged 164-byte checkpoint?
hypothesis: Opt-in transactional archiving of an observed active cell into one unused retained cell followed by recycling only that active cell preserves archived action evidence across contradictory new experiences, compared with reusing a single active cell; this is a functional retention mechanism, not generalization or a claim against equal-capacity conventional memory.
predecessor_evidence: DG1-MC01 draft PR #958 at 7c78ef0e7c3714a006599bbfb3a4d5e1fbccfddb: INVALID_DEV, leave independent/unmerged
Original main PublicCausalCells is an explicit memory control; no claim of native reasoning improvement

inputs.name: deterministic public-only binary intervention examples
inputs.sha256: generated deterministically by source tests, no external dataset
inputs.source: synthetic deterministic development fixtures defined in test source; never protected world data

frozen_design.capacity: exactly 7 active and 9 retained native slots, 16*2*2*2=128 learned bytes; checkpoint 164 bytes
frozen_design.data_budget: 24 observed binary outcomes per arm in initial task; 24 per arm in contradictory subsequent task; other cases bounded in unit tests
frozen_design.compute_budget: integer copies and checks over fixed 2x2 counters; no gradient, no external model, no new allocation beyond existing 16 cell slots
frozen_design.training: only preexisting observe(address, action, public_outcome) from actual public reports; no fabricated observations inserted
frozen_design.candidate: opt-in consolidate_and_recycle(active_address,retained_address), move exact counts to previously empty retained slot and atomically clear only source active slot; reject incomplete source, occupied destination, invalid addresses
frozen_design.comparator: unchanged original PublicCausalCells reused at same active site without archival; additional equal-capacity retained-slot manual-custody comparator treated as functionally equivalent
frozen_design.source_test_splits: finite public tests for two contradictory observed tasks; source-only developer check, no sealed primary cohort

controls: original choose() unchanged for all untouched cells
same-action evidence before archival and checkpoint restore
single active slot reused without archiving (interference control)
manually routed same-capacity retained cells (non-superiority control)
occupied destination and missing-arm evidence negative controls
tampered checkpoint and invalid type negative controls
metrics: archived action-choice parity before vs after recycling and contradictory next task
new active action-choice change after later observations
retained-capacity accounting and zero extra learned bytes
legacy source focused and final full regression on exact SHA, both platforms and G29 atlas

classification_rules.negative: record unsuccessful retention/compatibility controls exactly; no post-result test tuning
classification_rules.invalid: missing source custody, source mismatch, accidental protected data/runner use or unsupported scientific inference
